help.home: Quick match: referee right away, no teams to enter. New match: pick your teams and format. Refereeing: official match with lineup, substitutions and sanctions. Tactical board: draw and animate your plays.
help.referee: +1 gives the team the point, -1 removes one. After a point, choose who scored and how, or "Skip". Tap a team's timeout or substitution counter to use it. Undo reverts the last action. Rotations are automatic; the tactical icon opens the board.
help.arbitrage: Lineup: tap each court position to place a starter, then confirm. During the match: +1 gives the point, ⇄ swaps sides. Tap a player on the court to substitute them (or take the libero out). For each team: Substitution, Timeout (or tap the team's badge, its dots show the timeouts taken) and Card; Undo reverts the last action.
help.coach: Select a player at the top, then tap the action they made. Stats update in real time. The chart icon opens the match dashboard.
help.tactical: Drag a player anywhere; tap them to change number, name or colour. Bench: drop a substitute on a player to swap them, or on empty space to bring them on; drag a player to the bench to take them off. Arrows in two steps: 1. tap a player or the ball to select it (yellow halo); 2. draw the arrow anywhere, it starts from the selection. Tap an empty area to deselect. Pick a tool to draw: T1 animates the step (long-press: back to start), ⏮ ◀ ▶ replay step by step. 🗒 starts a blank board, ⋮ menu to load or save.
help.tacticalMatch: Drag a player anywhere; tap them to change number, name or colour. Bench: drop a substitute on a player to swap them, or on empty space to bring them on; drag a player to the bench to take them off. Arrows in two steps: 1. tap a player or the ball to select it (yellow halo); 2. draw the arrow anywhere, it starts from the selection. Tap an empty area to deselect. Pick a tool to draw: T1 animates the step (long-press: back to start), ⏮ ◀ ▶ replay step by step. 🗒 starts a blank board, ⋮ menu to load or save. From a match, the board is kept for that match; "Sync match" goes back to the match state. "Apply to match" records the substitutions during a set (rules checked, can be undone), or the starting lineup before the first point of a set.
help.teams: Tap a team to see and manage its players. + to create a team.
help.team: + adds a player: only the number is required. The scanner button imports players from a licence photo. Chart: player stats; bin: delete them.
help.newMatch: Choose the teams, format, mode and who serves first. The rules (sets, points, timeouts, substitutions) can be adjusted.
help.stats: Compare both teams skill by skill, see the top players and how points were scored. Tap a player to see their details.
help.history: Tap a match to resume it or see its summary, long-press to delete it. Filter by status or team.
help.settings: Change the language, turn vibrations on and replay the app help.
help.substitution: Choose who goes out, then who comes in. The libero ⚡ does not count towards the substitution limit.
help.lineup: Tick the players who are present, then tap the Starter / Bench badge to pick each team's starters. The libero ⚡ is handled separately.
help.tournaments: Your tournaments, most recent first. Everything stays on this phone: no account, no connection. "New tournament" opens a 4-step wizard.
help.tournamentWizard: 4 steps: details, format and rules, teams and schedule, summary. Suggested values follow the game type and the number of teams; you can change everything. "Redraw" draws the pools again before creating. "Save as template" keeps the rules and schedule (without the teams) for a next tournament.
help.tournament: Schedule: matches by time and court. Matches: filter by status, phase or team. Standings: pools, bracket and final ranking. Tap a match to enter or correct its score. The ⋯ menu renames teams, recomputes the schedule or deletes the tournament.

quickMatch.title: Quick match
quickMatch.body: One tap to get started. Tap +1 for the team that scores. Score, sets and rotations are handled for you.

arbitrage.title: Refereeing
arbitrage.body: Referee a real match under the official rules: starting lineup, substitutions, libero, timeouts and sanctions. The match is saved continuously, so you can resume it at any time.

tactical.title: Tactical board
tactical.body: Place your players anywhere, draw their movements and replay them step by step. Drag a substitute onto a player to swap them.

teams.title: Teams
teams.body: Create your teams in seconds: only the jersey number is required. Import your players from a licence photo 📷.

arbitrage.score: Tap the side of the team that wins the rally. Rotation is automatic.
arbitrage.sides: Swap sides to match the court as you see it.
arbitrage.actions: Substitution, Timeout and card (sanction), for each team. The team badge shows its timeouts: tap it to call one too.
arbitrage.undo: Made a mistake? Undo the last action, nothing is lost.

tactical.court: Drag a player anywhere on the court. Tap them to change their number or colour.
tactical.bench: Drop a substitute on a player to swap them. Drag a player here to take them off.
tactical.tools: 1. Tap a player or the ball (yellow halo). 2. Draw the arrow anywhere: they will follow it when you play the step. An empty area deselects.
tactical.steps: Tap “T1” to animate the step, long-press to go back to the start. Save from the ⋮ menu.
